verses.1: Why does the LORD stand in remote places, on high hills, during times of trouble?
verses.2: In the darkness of the wicked, poverty will be extinguished. They will be freed from these situations.
verses.3: For the wicked speak evil of their own hearts, and they commit acts that are contrary to God’s commands.
verses.4: The wicked, like a mountain that blocks the way, have no God to help them in their difficulties.
verses.5: May his ways be destroyed at every moment by your judgments against him. All his schemes will be foiled.
verses.6: He said in his heart, “May the Lord have mercy on those who do not do evil.”
verses.7: Allah’s words are full of lies and deceit. Beneath them lies hard work and suffering.
verses.8: They sit in the courtyards, in secret places. They kill Naqi’s eyes, so that they can escape.
verses.9: He will hunt in the darkness, like a lion in his den. He will hunt the poor and needy. The poor and needy will be caught in his traps.
verses.10: He will be defeated and fall into his own ruin. His army will be destroyed.
verses.11: He said in his heart, “I have forgotten. He has hidden his face from me forever.”
verses.12: May the LORD come to you; may your hands be raised. Do not forget the poor and needy.
verses.13: Why should the wicked man ever hope that God will not speak in his favor?
verses.14: She saw that you were tired and angry. You stared at it with your hands in your pockets. You would leave it alone. You were just being lazy.
verses.15: The wicked and evil ones will be punished for their evil deeds. But they will not be found anymore.
verses.16: YHWH, King of worlds, destroyed nations from their lands.
verses.17: You have heard the cries of the ungodly. LORD, prepare their hearts to listen to your words.
verses.18: To destroy both heaven and earth, in Bal-Yosif’s time, will still happen. Humans will be destroyed from the earth.
